title: Add designated freight forwarder to Customer master data
description: Add an optional designated freight-forwarder reference to Customer master data by reusing the existing BaseOtherInfo Forwarder dictionary. The field is master-data guidance only and must not automatically assign or authorize shipment records. Repository schema code and test-database validation are allowed; production database execution and deployment are prohibited.
acceptance_criteria: Customer create and edit workflows allow an optional designated freight forwarder selected from active BaseOtherInfo entries whose InfoType is Forwarder.
Customer list and detail views display the selected forwarder name while customers without a selection remain valid and unchanged.
The server rejects deleted, inactive or wrong-type dictionary entries and does not accept an arbitrary free-text value as an authoritative forwarder reference.
Deleting or deactivating a referenced dictionary entry does not corrupt historical customer reads; the unavailable reference is displayed explicitly and cannot be newly selected.
The new customer field does not automatically mutate ContainerBooking, loading, customs or expense records and does not grant access to any external forwarding system.
The schema change is backward compatible for existing customers and requires no production backfill.
Unit/integration tests cover create, update, clear, invalid type, inactive reference and existing-customer compatibility; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Edit a Customer, select an active Forwarder dictionary entry and verify it persists in list and detail views.
Clear the designated forwarder and verify no container or shipment document is changed automatically.

human_gate.reason: Local master-data code and test-database schema only. No production database operation, external forwarding integration, deployment or release is authorized.
